facts.activity_file: testing earth leakage and protection settings

control_failures.control_label: authorisation of switching and access to apparatus
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: preventive action - alarm rationalisation on SG-3100

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control SWITCHING_AUTHORISATION: the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work had been bypassed, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus on SG-3100 and TX-3001 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically testing earth leakage and protection settings. SG-3100 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during shift handover while the authorisation of switching and access to apparatus had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 15 February 2016 a corrective action on SG-3100 and TX-3001 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
